headline: Norton Study Reveals Emerging Risks for Kids Online, Prompting Parents to Have a New Kind of "The Talk"
summary: Parents are entering a new era of digital parenting, and it necessitates a new version of "the talk." According to the Norton Insights Report: Connected Kids, a new study from Norton, a Gen brand, 85% of parents of children under 18 say they feel comfortable talking to their children about online risks, yet 32% are not confident their child can distinguish AI-generated content from real content.
